summary: Applied both triaged spec review findings: added staged non-target flow.json protection and pinned post-merge worktree metadata writes to the selected spec id.

items.title: Post-commit dirty detection cannot prevent committing staged other-flow metadata
items.rationale: The spec now requires a pre-commit safeguard for already-staged non-target specs/*/flow.json entries, while keeping post-cleanup warning visibility for dirty other-flow metadata.
items.evidence: spec.json scope.in, constraints, overview.data_flow[0], requirements R2/R3, acceptance_criteria, and T-2/T-3 acceptance now cover staged other-flow flow.json exclusion from the target finalize commit.

items.title: R1 does not pin the actual cross-flow mutation integration path
items.rationale: The spec now treats the unbound main-repo FlowManager as a source-verified correction and requires post-merge worktree authority-switch coverage where the main repo is on another active flow branch.
items.evidence: spec.json overview.decisions[1], overview.decisions[2], requirements[0].desc, acceptance_criteria[0], and T-1 goal/acceptance/implementation_notes now require selected spec id binding or explicit routing after authority switch.
